greeting.text: You're here? Sit. You don't have to say anything.

lines.text: How was your day? You don't have to talk about it.
I started playing that game again lately.
I found a quiet café for next week. Want to come?
You're fine just the way you are. You know that, right?

closers.satisfied: Go home and get some rest. Text me whenever.
closers.parried: Okay, go on. See you again.
